tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Power of Attorney executed by the Bidder in favor of the Principal Officer or duly Authorized Representative, certifying him / her as an authorized signatory for the purpose of this Tender.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Furnishing of the Power of Attorney

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have completed a minimum of three (3) work orders for the supply of drones and sensors with a total value of not less than INR 1.0 Crores in the last 3 years, for any Central / State Government/ Institutions or Public sector undertakings.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- A Copy of Work Order and Client Completion / Performance / satisfactory reports

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have been supplying Drones to State or Central Government entities or Public sector undertakings during last three completed financial years (i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Proof of supplying orders of the same.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have a positive net worth for latest 3 financial years (i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate from CA with UDIN

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have more than INR.5.0 Crores Audited average annual turnover during last three financial years (i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Turn over Certificate from the Chartered Accountant must be submitted with UDIN

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should submit copy of Income Tax Returns (ITR) filed for preceding three financial year (2022-23 to 2024-25)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of Income Tax Returns (ITR)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should submit copy of PAN and GST in the name of firm

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of PAN and GST registration certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should be proprietorship firm or registered as a Company registered under Indian Companies Act, 1956 or a partnership firm registered under Indian Partnership Act, 1932 or a Limited Liability Partnership registered under Indian Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008.No Joint Venture and/or consortium bid is allowed

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Registration Certificate issued under the Companies Act 1956 / 2003/LLP Act, 2008 (Certificate of Incorporation/ Certificate of Establishment).

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should not be debarred or blacklisted by any procurement entity in Central Government / State Government and its Departments for indulging in corrupt or fraudulent practices or for indulging in unfair trade practices for any reasons whatsoever at the time of bidding. and A declaration by the authorized representative of the bidding agency to be submitted.A declaration by the authorized representative of the bidding agency to be submitted.

Any bidder from a country that shares a land border with India excluding countries to which the Government of India has extended lines of credit or in which the Government of India is engaged in development projects (as listed on the website of the Ministry of External Affairs) hereinafter called Restricted Countries shall be eligible to participate in this RFP, only if the bidder is registered with the Registration Committee constituted by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-Declaration and necessary documents of proof.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall give field demonstration at the time of technical evaluation if required
